Title: Extract Art

Images.AltText: Oil Painting
Oil Painting

Medium: Extract Art of drawing image

Title: Supper at Emmaus: Chiaroscuro Master Study

Images.AltText: Supper at Emmaus Chiaroscuro Oil Painting by Johar

Story: A master study executed in traditional oil painting techniques, honoring Caravaggio's dramatic chiaroscuro and intense psychological presence. The composition captures the miraculous revelation at Emmaus with rich impasto and tenebrist shadow play.
Medium: Oil on Canvas

Title: Shandur: The Mountain Polo Clash

Images.AltText: Shandur Mountain Polo Match Oil Painting by Johar

Story: A monumental panoramic canvas depicting the historic Shandur Polo Festival at 3,700 meters altitude. Expressive brushwork captures galloping polo ponies and riders across vivid emerald turf beneath northern peaks and a packed arena of spectators.
Medium: Oil and Acrylic on Canvas

Title: The Atelier Window with Brushes

Images.AltText: The Atelier Window with Studio Brushes Oil Painting by Johar

Story: An impressionistic atelier study capturing radiant morning light breaking across aged ochre plaster and rustic timber shutters, anchored by the artist's ceramic jar of studio brushes.
Medium: Oil on Archival Linen Panel

Title: Verdant Crescendo: Organic Gestures on Urban Grid

Images.AltText: Verdant Crescendo Expressionist Canvas in Gallery Frame by Johar

Story: A large-scale contemporary expressionist canvas exploring the dynamic tension between architectural rigidity and wild nature. Explosive calligraphic gestures in viridian and olive spring forth from a structured geometric matrix.
Medium: Oil and Mixed Media on Canvas in Oak Frame

Title: Ayat-e-Kareema: The Five-Panel Polyptych

Images.AltText: Ayat-e-Kareema Five-Panel Calligraphy Polyptych by Johar

Story: A monumental five-canvas polyptych rendering the sacred Ayat-e-Kareema (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin) in classical Thuluth script. Deep oxidized burnt umber margins and gilded leaf borders harmonize with flowing black lettering.
Medium: Acrylic, Sumi Ink, and 24K Gold Leaf on Canvas Polyptych

Title: Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ: The Sacred Name

Images.AltText: Framed Classical Arabic Calligraphy of Muhammad Mustafa by Johar

Story: Classical intertwined Thuluth and Diwani composition of the holy name 'Muhammad' with formal Salawat inscriptions below. Masterful control of pen angle, stroke weight, and ink saturation honoring Ottoman calligraphic traditions.
Medium: Japanese Ink on Archival Wasli Paper in Timber Frame

Title: Kun Fayakun & Afsana: Duality of Origin & Tale

Images.AltText: Kun Fayakun and Afsana Calligraphy Canvases by Johar

Story: A dual installation pairing the divine decree 'Kun Fayakun' sculpted from thousands of micro-calligraphic red and black strokes, with 'Afsana' rendered as a soaring silhouette of narrative script.
Medium: Acrylic and Calligraphic Ink on Stretched Archival Canvas

Title: Chromatic Calligraphic Triptych

Images.AltText: Chromatic Calligraphic Triptych by Johar

Story: Experimental calligraphic composition blending vertical gothicized arabesques in cobalt, vermilion, lemon yellow, and dense black ink, creating vibrant kinetic rhythms.
Medium: Gouache and Dense Ink on Heavyweight Paper

Title: Quaid-e-Azam: Portrait of Statesmanship

Images.AltText: Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah Charcoal Portrait by Johar
Quaid-e-Azam Portrait Atelier Studio Work in Progress

Story: A museum-grade formal portrait of Muhammad Ali Jinnah. Executed with fine academic chiaroscuro and tonal subtlety, rendering every nuance of facial structure, quiet resolve, and tailored sartorial elegance.
Medium: Charcoal and Carbon Graphite on Archival French Paper

Title: Bani Thani: The Miniature Reverie

Images.AltText: Bani Thani Mughal Miniature Painting and Preparatory Drawing by Johar

Story: A diptych study exploring classical Rajasthani and Mughal miniature portraiture. Contrasts the finished illuminated miniature crowned with a golden arch against its delicate preparatory silverpoint drawing.
Medium: Opaque Watercolor, 24K Shell Gold, and Graphite on Wasli Paper

Title: Academic Portrait Bust in Clay (Sculpture)

Images.AltText: Academic Clay Portrait Bust Sculpted in Atelier by Johar

Story: Life-size academic clay portrait bust sculpted in the atelier from a live sitter. Showcases anatomical fidelity, expressive facial planes, and tactile tool marks.
Medium: Terracotta Modeling Clay on Wooden Armature

Title: The Gathered Elders: Life Drawing Conclave

Images.AltText: The Gathered Elders Observational Charcoal Life Drawing by Johar

Story: A monumental observational figure study drawn live in the grand atelier hall. Documents three seated elders in traditional dress conversing, balancing academic weight with rhythmic tonal hatching.
Medium: Willow Charcoal and Carbon Pencil on Heavyweight Cartridge Paper

Title: Solitude in the Gallery: The Attendant

Images.AltText: Solitude in the Gallery Charcoal Drawing by Johar

Story: A poignant narrative charcoal drawing depicting a museum gallery attendant seated on the floor beside a potted flowering shrub, reflecting on space, labor, and quiet contemplation.
Medium: Compressed Charcoal and Blending Stumps on Bristol Board

Title: Elder in Contemplation: Blue Ballpoint Study

Images.AltText: Elder in Contemplation Blue Ballpoint Pen Study by Johar

Story: A virtuoso drawing executed entirely with blue ballpoint pen. Dynamic cross-hatching and pressure modulation capture the dignified weariness and contemplative posture of a seated patriarch.
Medium: Blue Ballpoint Pen on Heavyweight Paper

Title: Feeling Alone: Psychological Sketchbook Studies

Images.AltText: Feeling Alone Figure Studies in Charcoal by Johar
Inner Echoes Psychological Charcoal Sketch by Johar

Story: Expressive sketchbook series exploring vulnerability, solitary reflection, and inner architectural spaces through diverse figure postures and swirling charcoal gradients.
Medium: Graphite, Charcoal, and Pastel on Spiral Sketchbook Paper

Title: Nocturne of the Oceanic Form (White on Black)

Images.AltText: Nocturne Still Life in White Chalk on Black Board by Johar

Story: An inverse tonal still life drawn with white chalk on pitch-black paper. Explores specular highlights, plush textile textures, and reflective spectacles against profound darkness.
Medium: White Conté Crayon and Chalk on Black Archival Board

Title: Wazir Khan Minaret: Architectural Study

Images.AltText: Wazir Khan Mosque Minaret Watercolor and Ink Drawing by Johar

Story: Precise architectural study of the historic 17th-century Mughal minaret of Wazir Khan Mosque in Lahore. Detailed line work documents decorative tile mosaics (kashi-kari), balconies, and soaring avian silhouettes.
Medium: Fine Ink Line and Watercolor Wash on 300gsm Cold-Press Paper

Title: Mughal Floral Fresco: Islimi on Wasli

Images.AltText: Mughal Floral Fresco Islimi Study on Wasli Paper by Johar

Story: Traditional miniature painting study recreating Mughal floral fresco patterns with ground mineral pigments on genuine wasli. Intricate brush rendering of bellflowers and leaves on vibrant saffron ground.
Medium: Natural Mineral Pigments and Gouache on Hand-Burnished Wasli Paper

Title: Traces of Observation: The Master Print Edition

Images.AltText: Traces of Observation Polychrome Intaglio Etching Print by Johar
Traces of Observation Black and White Carbon Print State
Traces of Observation Cyan Monochrome Print on Deckle Paper
Traces of Observation Violet Monochrome Print State
Traces of Observation Iridescent Multi-Plate Print State

Story: A celebrated fine art printmaking edition (signed A/P M. Bashir - 26). Still life of laboratory glassware, brass plates, and horn instruments with figures sketching in the plate tone, pulled across multiple monochrome and polychrome states.
Medium: Hand-pulled Intaglio Hard-Ground Etching and Aquatint on Rives BFK Paper

Title: The Fallen Stag & The Ravens: Intaglio Suite

Images.AltText: The Fallen Stag and Ravens Intaglio Etching Print by Johar
The Fallen Stag Zinc Etching Plate and Preparatory Drawing

Story: Allegorical intaglio print exploring mortality and nature. Depicts a recumbent stag on riverbank shallows watched by descending ravens, accompanied by documented zinc etching plates.
Medium: Zinc Plate Intaglio Etching with Drypoint on Heavyweight Rag Paper

Title: The Cubist Sentinel: Man of Prisms (Sculpture)

Images.AltText: The Cubist Sentinel Man of Prisms Cardboard Sculpture by Johar
Cubist Sentinel Sculpture 3/4 Angle View
Cubist Sentinel Sculpture Side Profile in Studio
Cubist Sentinel Sculpture Kneeling Dynamic Pose
Cubist Sentinel Sculpture Top-Down Geometric View

Story: A life-scale constructivist and cubist sculpture assembled from interlocking geometric cardboard modules and white triangular prisms, forming a kneeling mechanical automaton in dynamic repose.
Medium: Structural Corrugated Cardboard, Heavy Kraft Paper, and Geometric Prisms

Title: Devotional Relic: Tasbih on Pierced Porcelain

Images.AltText: Devotional Relic Tasbih on Pierced Porcelain Dish by Johar

Story: An inventive sacred artwork marrying ceramic sculpture with miniature painting. The center of an ornate pierced porcelain dish bears an illusionistic trompe-l'œil painting of an obsidian tasbih and prayer stone.
Medium: Miniature Acrylic and Enamel on Vintage Reticulated Pierced Porcelain Dish

Title: The Mechanical Allegory: Excavator of Memory

Images.AltText: The Mechanical Allegory Excavator Collage by Johar
The Mechanical Allegory Collage on Gallery Exhibition Wall

Story: A large-scale architectural and socio-political collage shaped as a construction excavator. Incorporates authentic cement sacks, architectural sketches, and figures examining historical displacement.
Medium: Mixed Media Collage, Cement Bag Ephemera, and Ink on Cutout Foam Board

Title: Topographical Totem: Tactile Studio Exploration

Images.AltText: Topographical Totem Wood Sculpture and Map Installation by Johar
Topographical Totem Installation Overhead View

Story: An interactive studio sculpture featuring a hand-carved cylindrical wooden totem inscribed with contour lines, set atop an unfolding map of topographic surveys and geological fragments.
Medium: Turned Hardwood, Pyrography, and Topographic Ink Drawings on Cotton Rag

Title: Ephemeral Portrait in Seeds

Images.AltText: Ephemeral Portrait in Black Nigella Seeds on Dough by Johar

Story: A pointillist culinary portrait composed entirely from thousands of individual black sesame and nigella seeds distributed over raw dough, celebrating transient and ephemeral mediums.
Medium: Organic Black Nigella Seeds (Kalonji) on Unbaked Bread Dough

Title: Civic Murals: The Instructional Narrative

Images.AltText: Civic Wall Mural Painting in Progress by Johar
Artist Johar Seated Beside Completed Garden Mural

Story: Public community mural painting blending playful figurative illustrations with crisp hand-lettered signwriting, captured during execution on an architectural multi-striped facade.
Medium: Weather-Resistant Exterior Acrylic on Plastered Concrete Wall

Title: The Parched Earth: Elegy of the Fallen Crane

Images.AltText: The Parched Earth Fallen Crane Charcoal Drawing in Gallery Frame by Johar
The Fallen White Bird on Cracked Soil Close-up Charcoal Study

Story: A powerful ecological allegory confronting climate crisis, drought, and vulnerability. A solitary crane lies fallen across deeply fractured, parched earth, rendered with intense chiaroscuro and atmospheric perspective stretching to the horizon.
Medium: Charcoal, Carbon Pencil, and White Chalk on Heavyweight Paper in Oak Frame

Title: The Fallen Raven: Requiem of the Drought

Images.AltText: The Fallen Raven Charcoal Drawing on Cracked Earth by Johar

Story: Companion to the parched earth suite. Depicts a fallen raven with spread plumage against an arid desert floor, exploring the stark tactile textures of cracked mud and dark iridescent feathers.
Medium: Charcoal and White Chalk on Toned Archival Paper in Gilded Slip

Title: The Elder of the North: Portrait in Pakol

Images.AltText: The Elder of the North Charcoal and Graphite Portrait by Johar

Story: An evocative academic portrait of an elderly northern patriarch wearing spectacles and a traditional woollen Pakol. Masterful graphite cross-hatching renders every weathered fold, furrowed brow, and soft fabric weave with profound dignity.
Medium: Graphite and Carbon Pencil on Heavyweight Archival Paper

Title: The Scholar's Reverie: Portrait in Spectacles

Images.AltText: The Scholar's Reverie Charcoal Portrait by Johar

Story: Fine tonal portrait of a contemplative scholar with spectacles, captured mid-thought with his hand gracing his chin. Subtle atmospheric shading and light reflections on glass lenses.
Medium: Graphite and Blended Charcoal on Cartridge Paper

Title: Innocence & Resilience: Study of Youth

Images.AltText: Innocence and Resilience Youth Charcoal Portrait by Johar

Story: An expressive study of childhood capturing vulnerability, resilience, and quiet strength. Soft charcoal modeling highlights dramatic three-quarter lighting across cheekbones and deep, inquiring eyes.
Medium: Charcoal and Soft Graphite on Archival Paper

Title: Luminous Joy: Portrait of a Young Woman

Images.AltText: Luminous Joy Portrait of a Young Woman by Johar

Story: Lyrical graphite portrait capturing spontaneous joy and warmth. Flowing hair and delicate tonal shading celebrate radiant facial expression and gentle movement. Signed by Johar.
Medium: Graphite, Charcoal, and Blending Stump on Paper

Title: The Patriot: Portrait Study in Graphite

Images.AltText: The Patriot Character Study in Graphite by Johar

Story: Academic portrait study exploring historical character, traditional headgear, and determined gaze, rendered with crisp graphite linework and deep charcoal vignette contrast.
Medium: Carbon Pencil and Graphite on Toned Paper with Vignette

Title: Urban Contemplation: Portrait against Cracked Masonry

Images.AltText: Urban Contemplation Portrait in Charcoal by Johar

Story: Figurative portrait of a young man positioned against deeply veined, cracked stucco walls, bridging human portraiture with urban textural decay.
Medium: Compressed Charcoal and Powdered Graphite on Paper

Title: The Classical Philosopher in the Colonnade

Images.AltText: The Classical Philosopher in the Colonnade Watercolor by Johar

Story: An architectural and figurative academic study honoring neoclassical traditions. Depicts an ancient bearded philosopher in draped terracotta robes seated amidst marble Corinthian columns, examining a scroll.
Medium: Sepia Ink, Gouache, and Watercolor Glazes on Archival Paper

Title: Chromatic Mosaic: Collage Portrait of a Woman

Images.AltText: Chromatic Mosaic Collage Portrait in Painted Paper by Johar

Story: Contemporary mixed media portrait assembled entirely from meticulously hand-cut and torn painted papers. Vibrant cobalt, warm sienna, and cerulean hues coalesce into an expressive portrait of a smiling woman.
Medium: Painted Paper Collage, Gouache, and Printed Ephemera on Canvas Board
